attchmntText: Precision Camshafts Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Newspaper Advertisement pursuant to Regulation 47 (1) (b) ofthe SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015   UnauditedStandalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year endedSeptember 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Precision Camshafts Limited published a newspaper advertisement on November 08, 2026, in Tarun Bharat and November 07, 2026, in Business Standard, pursuant to Regulation 47 of SEBI LODR Regulations. This advertisement contains a QR code and details for accessing the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were approved by the Board of Directors on November 06, 2026, and are available on the company website at www.pclindia.in and stock exchange websites. The document also includes an extract of financial results from Precision Camshafts Limited's holding company, Shanthala Fittings and Components Limited, for the same period. Additionally, Shanthala Fittings and Components Limited announced its 12th Annual General Meeting scheduled for November 30, 2026, to be held via video conferencing.

attchmntText: Precision Camshafts Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
